description: This Java source file defines the RetireSaveHandler class, which implements logic to handle setting or clearing retirement metadata (retiredBy, dateRetired, retireReason) on objects that implement the Retireable interface within the OpenMRS framework. It is involved in ensuring consistent handling of 'retired' state during save operations, particularly in the context of OpenMRS's AOP-based data handling.

classes.name: RetireSaveHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages setting or clearing retirement-related attributes on Retireable objects before they are saved.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the setting or clearing of retiredBy, dateRetired, and retireReason fields on a Retireable object based on its retired status.
